findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: npt_pipe_thread, search_threads, list_threads · Private data: baby_name_totals · Public sink: parse_ingredients, convert_ingredient, baby_name_by_state, trending_baby_names, baby_names_of_a_decade · Destructive: convert_coordinates, identify_coordinate, distance_between_points.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: npt_pipe_thread, search_threads, list_threads · Private data: baby_name_totals · Public sink: parse_ingredients, convert_ingredient, baby_name_by_state, trending_baby_names, baby_names_of_a_decade · Destructive: convert_coordinates, identify_coordinate, distance_between_points

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
